SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Aspar.]
Frequent sneezing ; after smelling tincture.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Aspar.]
Countenance pale, wax-like and bloated.
General expression of anxiety and distress. See 29.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Aspar.]
Relieved toothache.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Aspar.]
Deglutition difficult. θ Hydrophobia.
Burning in throat.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Aspar.]
Frequent urination, with fine stinging in meatus, followed by stitches out of urethra.
Urine scanty, straw-colored and offensive.
Increased urine beer-brown, without sediment.
When urinating, particularly when voiding last drops, rheumatic, constricting pain in cardiac region, forcing him to cry out ; turns blue in face. θ Dropsy of chest.
Lithiasis.
Gravel passing in small quantities with urination.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Aspar.]
Relieved prurigo pudendi in woman, æt. 40.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Aspar.]
Great oppression ; breathing rapid, difficult, increased after being in bed some time.
Breathing : rapid, labored, sighing ; difficult when moving or ascending ; difficult at night ; must sit up in bed.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Aspar.]
Hydrothorax ; often with heart disease or gouty diathesis of old people.
Unusual fulness of chest.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Aspar.]
Heart's throb visible, especially at night ; very strong and extended over an unnaturally large area ; throbbing carotids ; murmurs.
Palpitation ; while siting, leaves of book in his hand tremble ; with anxious restlessness, increased by motion or ascending ; with oppression of chest.
Heart's action weak ; pulse feeble. See 32.
Heart's stroke twofold, irregular, quickened.
Pulse accelerated when sitting ; slow, weak ; irregular and feeble.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Aspar.]
Pains on tip of left shoulder.
Pain at acromion process of left scapula, under clavicle and down left arm ; pulse feeble.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Aspar.]
Motion aggravates most pains.
   

NERVES. [36] [Aspar.]
Great languor and disinclination to physical or mental exertion.
   

FEVER. [40] [Aspar.]
Suppression of sweat.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Aspar.]
Dropsies. See Hydrothorax, 28.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Aspar.]
Numbness of the bitten part, extending over the whole arm. θ Hydrophobia.
Constant desire to be carried about in the arms.
